seg1.prompt: An elderly bald man in a green robe, the painter Hokusai, sits on plain cream paper. He looks up with a bright, knowing smile and lifts his hand as if holding a brush. Bold strokes of Prussian blue ink sweep across the paper behind him, swelling and curling into a giant wave with claw-like white foam. The ink wave rushes forward and fills the whole screen, and Hokusai fades away as the scene becomes the woodblock print 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa', with three boats and a small Mount Fuji in the distance. Striking, eye-catching transformation. Japanese brush painting turning into flat ukiyo-e woodblock print style, crisp outlines, paper texture.

seg2.prompt: The Great Wave surges upward and towers higher and higher, its claw-like white foam curling forward over the boats while the rowers duck low. The camera pushes in toward the crest. Then the wave crashes down and a burst of white spray sweeps across the entire frame, covering everything. The spray thins and drifts away like clouds, and the sky clears to reveal Mount Fuji glowing red at dawn under rows of white mackerel clouds on a deep blue sky. The camera pulls back to show the whole print. Powerful, fast motion at the start, calm at the end. Flat ukiyo-e woodblock print style, crisp outlines, paper texture.
